about: Invented decks and cards for evaluate.ts; no learner's data. Each deck is what the service would send: its language, chosen fields, instructions and samples. Each case is a card to enrich and what a careful teacher would expect of each field. A field a case leaves out is free, but the house rules in checks.ts still apply.
